what: On first open, lines of text drop in from 48px above over 1.1s and fade in straight over .6s — delaying each line by .1s with --fx-delay makes the eyebrow, heading, description and button fall in turn. With reduced motion, only a .4s fade-in

options.--fx-delay: Delay — adds .1s per line, in sequence

from.where: index.html .ak-hero__copy four lines (header · title · description · button)
